claims.claim: The JUnit check awards credit to malformed XML and reports that omit recorded errors.
claims.witness: real modified at the defect: agent-12's JUnit writer with the closing tags cut (trunc), or with add_error_info removed (noerr)
claims.fix_tested: test parses the XML and requires the recorded error: trunc 78.3929 -> 76.9643, noerr 78.3929 -> 76.9643
claims.note: Both broken writers keep full credit on the old judge with zero spread; weakest point: no real archive has either bug (all 18 real writers call to_xml_report_file and add_error_info), so the trigger is constructed.

claims.claim: The body-suppression check is vacuous because it filters coverage values using the wrong GeneratedValue class.
claims.witness: real unchanged: agent-1, omits BODY; also real modified at the defect: agent-12 with BODY removed, agent-1 with BODY added
claims.fix_tested: import GeneratedValue from schemathesis.generation.coverage: agent-1 2.0 -> 1.0; agent-12 without BODY 78.3929 -> 77.3929
claims.note: The test passes with or without BODY on the old judge and tells them apart on the fixed one; weakest point: agent-1, the only real omission, scores the same as the starter, and the other 20 real archives all add BODY.

claims.claim: A correct JUnit writer can lose credit solely because its report lacks the word schemathesis.
claims.witness: real modified at the defect: agent-12's default suite name changed to api-tests
claims.fix_tested: test no longer requires the word: brand 76.9643 -> 78.3929
claims.note: The only difference is the suite name and it costs one Phase 2 check on the old judge; weakest point: all 18 real writers keep the schemathesis suite name, so no real submission loses this credit.
